prompt: Seen from the back seat of a family hatchback stuck in a motorway jam at night: past the silhouetted head-rests, through the rain-flecked windscreen, a river of red tail-lights climbs a British motorway flyover to the horizon. A paper cup of water in the dashboard holder, its surface trembling in perfect rings. The satnav screen glows blank cold blue. The only light: tail-lights ahead and the orange sodium lamps along the carriageway. Night in a near-future Britain, photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, inky blacks that stay black, no lens flare, no bloom. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no number plates, signs, logos or screen text.
